title: Coherent Quantum Schrodinger Bridge: Two-Boundary Optimal Control for Quantum Algorithm Design
summary: Quantum algorithms are intrinsically two-boundary processes: an input state is prepared, and an output state or subspace is selected as the computational answer. We formulate this observation as a coherent Quantum Schrödinger Bridge (QSB), a pure-state Hamiltonian counterpart of Schrödinger bridge theory in which the endpoint constraint is imposed on state vectors and the transport cost is the quadratic control action.
